_comment: Copy the `mcpServers` block into your MCP client configuration.
Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO with the real path in both places.
LOMST_HOME is required: the server starts with an arbitrary working directory.
GITHUB_TOKEN            raises the GitHub API limit from 60 to 5000 req/h
LOMST_ALLOW_DECISIONS=1 lets record_decision write approvals. Off by
default so the assistant hands a command to a human
instead - Section 13 step 4 is an act by a named
